items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 46:1
items.html: At the time when AVI are face-to-back, the ZON of Ima are included in the GAR of Ima and have no revelation, because the very essence of ZON is the illumination of Chochma that they receive from Ima, and Ima cannot draw the illumination of Chochma before she turns face-to-face with Abba. But when she receives MAN and turns her face to Abba, she then begets the Mochin for ZON, and then the ZAT are revealed in Ima herself as well, and she now has ten complete Sefirot. These ZAT that are now revealed are called the Mocha DeDaat. (Inner Light, page 645, Sub Header, “And In This”)
